tools.name: render_track_results
tools.description: Display previously retrieved MusicAtlas similar-track results in an interactive audio player. Accepts the source track, matching tracks, and optional hashtags. Does not perform a new search. Intended for clients that use a separate rendering step; find_similar_tracks also supports direct rendering.

tools.name: find_similar_artists
tools.description: Find artists that are sonically similar or musically adjacent to a specific artist. Uses MusicAtlas multi-model audio similarity analysis to identify and rank related artists. Results include artist names, similarity scores, and MusicAtlas artist URLs.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "find_similar_artists" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Find artists that are similar, sonically related, or musically adjacent to a specific artist. Use when a user asks for artists like or similar to a named artist. Results include ranked artist matches, MusicAtlas artist URLs, and supporting track examples." → after: "Find artists that are sonically similar or musically adjacent to a specific artist. findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
